title: Chris Jones added to the Chiefs injury report on Friday

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Chris Jones added to the Chiefs injury report on Friday
sources.description: There was a single change on either team’s practice participation report on Friday with Kansas City Chiefs’ defensive lineman Chris Jones getting limited by a calf issue. We’ll have to see what they do with him on Saturday’s practice and official game status. For the Denver Broncos, having Jones limited inside would certainly be helpful […]
